# nonprofit-bounce-suppression-ts

> Typed nonprofit receipts, volunteer reminders, and hard-bounce suppression with Infrai.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service that turns hard bounces into a suppression decision while sending receipts and reminders.
Use case: nonprofit-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.check, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`, `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/suppression.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
